## Core Technical Specializations

- **Enterprise LLMs & Agentic RAG:** Hybrid retrieval (`PostgreSQL + pgvector`, `Milvus`, `ChromaDB`, `Pinecone`, `FAISS`), `LangGraph`, `LangChain`, `Pydantic AI`, `AutoGen`, Model Context Protocol (`MCP`), sovereign/local LLM serving (`vLLM`), semantic caching, token optimization (66–83% cost reduction), and citation-grounded compliance.
- **Real-Time Voice & Conversational AI:** Sub-200ms telephony audio bridges (`Twilio Media Streams`, `FastAPI`, `WebSockets`, `WebRTC`, `Vapi.ai`, `Gemini Live API`), Bangla-first & multilingual STT/TTS.
- **Computer Vision, Biometrics & Document AI:** Age-invariant face recognition (`SFace`), anti-spoofing liveness, WebRTC fingerprint matching (`ORB + Gabor`), industrial anomaly & workforce analytics (`YOLO`, `OpenCV`, `PyTorch`), Bangladesh NID e-KYC OCR, Mushok VAT invoice extraction (23 fields), and clinical prescription parsing (`Google Cloud Document AI`).
- **Multi-Cloud Architecture & DevSecOps:** Certified across Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Oracle Cloud (`OCI`), with production delivery extending to Alibaba and Tencent Cloud; `Kubernetes`, `Docker`, `Helm`, `Terraform`, `Ansible`, `Pulumi`, `GitHub Actions`, `Azure DevOps`, `ArgoCD`, `MLflow`, `BigQuery`, and Zero-Trust security (`SOC2`, `HIPAA`, `GDPR`).

## Flagship Production Systems & Quantified Impact

- **CropMind (Google Cloud Gen AI Academy APAC 2026 Grand Finale — Top 10 of 192,660):** Autonomous multi-agent agritech platform built with `LangGraph`, `Gemini 2.5`, computer vision, RAG, `Cloud Run`, `BigQuery`, and `Vertex AI`; recognized as the only Bangladeshi in the official APAC Top 10.
- **Enterprise Multi-Tenant RAG Platform:** Production vector search serving **100K+ queries/day** across 50K+ documents with **99%+ retrieval accuracy** and strict tenant isolation.
- **Bangla-First Voice AI Call Center:** Real-time conversational telephony bridge (`Twilio` + `FastAPI` + `Gemini Live API`) achieving **<200ms latency** and **60% support cost reduction**.
- **Banking KYC, FaceTrack AI & Sovereign Document Suite:** Multi-tenant identity verification, 28+ attendance/biometric REST APIs, bilingual Bangladesh NID OCR, and 23-field Mushok VAT invoice automation.
- **McKrishiSheba Agricultural AI:** HNSW `pgvector` search + Bangla STT/TTS advisory system that reduced LLM inference costs by **66–83%**.
- **Explainable Network Intrusion Detection ([Public Repo](https://github.com/brlikhon/Network-Intrusion-dataset-CIC-IDS--2017-)):** 12-model ML pipeline on **2.8M+ CIC-IDS-2017 records** classifying 15 attack types at **99.87% accuracy** and **99.99% ROC-AUC** with `SHAP` & `LIME` forensic explainability.
- **InsureCow Serverless Cattle Muzzle Identification:** Migrated computer-vision livestock underwriting inference to `AWS Lambda`, cutting infrastructure cost by **70%**.
